digest.component_or_area: LLM gate economics and plan-review/code-review verification system
propositions: Per-gate LLM costs measured: plan-review 3.02 dollars/run, code-review 1.42 dollars/run, completion-verifier 2.24 dollars/run; per-ticket mean 11.85 dollars for completed work.
Cheap-model experiments (Nova Pro, Haiku, Nova 2 Lite) rejected for agentic review due to tool-looping failures and false-accept epochs; Sonnet retained for completion verification at parity.

Code-review blocking is determined by criterion routing (only security enabled) and unreachable 0.95 threshold, not severity axes; 98.2% of findings routed to non-blocking paths before impact scoring consulted.

Overlap-drain mechanism has surfaced zero findings across 2093 plan reviews and should be disabled or redesigned; batch-path verdicts carry confidence 0.0 preventing any breach of 0.7 conjunction bar.
Ordinal-to-binary migration plan (phases 0-3) designed with verification replay validation; operator approval required before execution; phase 3 depends on code-review blocking-rule repair.

Two observability.sh metric-emission defects identified: cold-start offset seeding inflates counts on first run after metrics added (widespread-zealous-narwhal), and unanchored grep patterns match LLM prose as false errors (colossal-slothful-grouse).
